output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-5b589d797835] is a bare metric name, but its section [ev-1f419676f177] states the change: in 3.0.0, metrics with the `cortex_` prefix now start with `loki_` because `metrics_namespace` defaults to `loki`, so `cortex_dns_lookups_total` becomes `loki_dns_lookups_total`. The same section gives the condition and the workaround: setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` keeps the old name, but that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. So the subject (this metric), the change (renamed by changing its prefix), who is exposed (the default namespace) and the consequence (the metric no longer exists under its old name) can all be written from the evidence.
